decisions.reason: As a close-to-core perfect binder it still fits the firm’s broad finishing portfolio and service model, but compared with the more automated offer its likely aspiration level is harder to meet, so management would keep it while accepting a moderate risk of withdrawal.

The fully automatic perfect binder matches the firm’s stated direction toward automation and productivity, so with its strong complementarity to existing sales and service resources management would be inclined to continue backing it unless results clearly disappoint.

This booklet maker supports the push into digital print finishing and nearline/inline workflows, and the firm’s portfolio breadth and organisational slack make continued offering more likely than exit despite some uncertainty from limited later market evidence.
